name: Korah (Esau's son with Oholibama)
title: Edomite tribal chief
summary: Korah was one of the sons of Esau and his wife Oholibama, daughter of Anah. He became a tribal chief (aluf) among the Edomites in the mountains of Seir. He represents one of the Edomite clans established as part of Esau's descendants.
relatedPersons: Reuel, son of Esau and Bashemath

keyEvents.title: Korah's birth as Esau's son
keyEvents.description: Korah was born as the son of Esau and Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, son of Zibeon, in the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Family Moves to Seir
keyEvents.description: Esau took his wives, sons, daughters, and all his household with him and moved to the hill country of Seir, away from his brother Jacob, because the land could not support them both.

keyEvents.title: Korah Mentioned Among Oholibamah's Sons
keyEvents.description: Korah is listed along with his brothers Jeush and Jalam as sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah. These were born in Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Korah Becomes a Clan Chief in Edom
keyEvents.description: Korah was appointed as one of the clan chiefs (alufim) among Esau's descendants through Oholibamah, thus gaining a leading role among the Edomites.

keyEvents.title: Overview of Edom's Chiefs
keyEvents.description: Korah is mentioned in the combined list of clan chiefs descended from Esau, who is the ancestor of Edom, in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Edom's Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Korah's name is repeated in the historical genealogy in 1 Chronicles as one of Esau's sons by Oholibamah.
